facts.cushion-seat: She sits comfortably, leaning back on a seat spread with red cushions and cloth.
facts.star-crown: On her head is a crown set with white stars, with a green leaf wreath beneath it.
facts.scepter: In her right hand she holds a scepter with a round ball at its tip.
facts.pomegranate-gown: Her white dress is covered with a red pomegranate pattern.
facts.venus-shield: At the lower left is a heart-shaped shield marked with the Venus sign (♀).
facts.wheat-field: In front of her spreads a field of wheat, ripe and yellow.
facts.forest-stream: Behind her is a dense forest, and a stream of water flows down on the right.

glosses.wheat-field: Fruit that ripens in proportion to the care given.
glosses.cushion-seat: Something that grows in comfort rather than through effort.
glosses.venus-shield: The strength of the side that protects love and beauty.

reversedGloss.excess: Caring goes too far and smothers the other person, or empties out her own self.
reversedGloss.waning: Ease and enjoyment are drying up.
reversedGloss.blocked: Something she was nurturing seems to have stalled and feels slow.

misdescriptions.wrong: She is a pregnant woman with a swollen belly.
The shield is on the right.
